title: Difficulty and course
summary: The course speeds up and HP drains faster the further Ade runs. Each difficulty builds its course from random blocks.

sections.title: Difficulty
sections.note: Speed is the scroll speed in course units a second (the same units as the metres counted for distance, as far as the table shows). Block numbers are averages per block.

sections.title: What a coin spot can hold
sections.note: Each spot in a block rolls its contents when the block appears (chances per 10,000, shown as %). Spots are counted over every block of every difficulty.
